meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 此技能为 NanoClaw 添加 Signal 通道:通过 signal-cli 以次要设备链接到你的现有手机号码,不注册新号。之后助手可用该号码收发 Signal 消息,并支持 Markdown、引用回复、打字指示等功能。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 接入 Signal 通道,或在进行整体设置并走到这一步时触发。随后执行安装、设备链接、保存账号和接线步骤。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 接入 Signal 通道
say.note: 会安装依赖并开始设备链接流程。

say.text: 扫描二维码,把 Signal 链接到我的手机
say.note: 生成约 3 分钟有效的链接二维码,扫描后完成绑定。

say.text: 把 Signal 设为我的消息渠道并接线
say.note: 保存手机号并配置消息组,之后即可收发。

howto.what_en: Adds a Signal channel to NanoClaw via signal-cli device-link. The assistant joins your existing number as a linked device (no new number) and sends/receives Signal messages as that number. Supports Markdown, quoted replies, typing indicators, Note to Self.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Signal as a channel to NanoClaw, or during the NanoClaw setup flow at the channel step. It installs prerequisites, links your phone via QR, persists the account, and wires messaging groups.

say_en.text: Add a Signal channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Runs install and starts device linking.

say_en.text: Scan the QR code to link Signal to my phone.
say_en.note: Shows a QR that expires in ~3 minutes.

say_en.text: Set up Signal as my messaging channel.
say_en.note: Saves the account and wires the channel.
